guides.title: User Guide
guides.subtitle: Step-by-step interactive operational guide to valorize your parcels and certify climate resilience.
guides.step1_desc: Enter your parcel name, select your municipality from the dropdown or click 'Use Current GPS Position', and draw your field polygon on the NASA satellite map to auto-calculate the area in hectares.
guides.step2_desc: Access high-resolution soil physics and chemistry modeled by SoilGrids across 3 standard depth intervals (pH, organic carbon, nitrogen, CEC, sand/silt/clay fractions).
guides.step3_desc: The agronomic engine cross-references 30-year NASA POWER climate trends and soil properties to recommend the Top 3 optimal crops with yield, net margin, and inflation risk calculations.
guides.step4_desc: Issue an official tamper-proof digital certificate sealed with SHA-256 cryptographic hashing and QR verification to access green finance and certified bank loans.

about.title: About TerraLux AI
about.subtitle: TerraLux AI is a decision-support tool for farmers and governments. It uses data from NASA and SoilGrids to certify parcel resilience.
about.mission_text: TerraLux AI is a decision-support tool for farmers and governments. It uses data from NASA and SoilGrids to certify the resilience of parcels. Our platform addresses food sovereignty in Luxembourg and climate resilience in Madagascar (Diana Region).
about.team_text: A multidisciplinary team of agronomists, data scientists, and climate finance specialists committed to sustainable and sovereign agriculture.
about.science_nasa: NASA POWER & NASA GIBS: 30-year climate baselines and daily TrueColor satellite imagery.
about.science_soil: ISRIC SoilGrids: Multi-depth calibrated pedological layers (clay, pH, organic carbon, CEC).
about.science_fao: FAO ECOCROP: Certified agro-ecological rules across temperate and tropical crop species.
